name: WaveGradient
description: Stripe-style stacked bands of gradient color drawn on Canvas 2D, each layer undulating on two summed sine waves with a fine highlight ridge, over a tilted field with configurable layer count and amplitude.
a11yNotes: The canvas and shading overlay are aria-hidden; children render above in normal reading order. The loop pauses when off-screen or at speed 0; prefers-reduced-motion paints one static frame. Handles devicePixelRatio and container resizes via ResizeObserver.

propsApi.name: amplitude
propsApi.description: Wave amplitude in px at 360px height (scales with height).

propsApi.name: layers
propsApi.description: Number of stacked wave layers, clamped to 2–6.

propsApi.name: angle
propsApi.description: Tilt of the wave field in degrees.

propsApi.name: blur
propsApi.description: Softening blur applied to the waves in px.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the background in px.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Content rendered centered on top; defaults to a heading and subline.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
